targets.subject: A data nerd published his startup predictions and the scorecard (0-for-10 first cohort, on purpose)
targets.body:
Hi Connie,

Quick one for StrictlyVC. An independent researcher has been publishing a pre-registered list of ten startups every week, ranked by public GitHub engineering velocity across 350+ startup orgs. The unusual part: he grades each list in public, 60 days later, misses included.

The first cohort was locked May 4 and graded July 31. It came back 0-for-10: none of the ten announced a raise in the window. He published that scorecard anyway, and the full ledger is live here: https://signals.gitdealflow.com/predicted

That transparency is the story. Venture's alternative-data products sell cherry-picked backtests. This is someone running the forward test in the open, because the underlying methodology (SSRN 6606558) reports a 3.4x lift and a 21 to 47 day median lead across 219 backtested rounds, and he would rather have that edge audited than oversold.

Everything is free and public: methodology, CC BY 4.0 dataset, grading rubric. No fund behind it. Happy to send charts or put you in touch with The Data Nerd (signals@gitdealflow.com).

The Data Nerd
